how: As local-screen-v1.json (smoke, pdf-brief and board-pack, each run twice, against llama.cpp b11050 on an RTX 3080 held to an 8 GB card's budget, with the app's preset: a 32,768-token window and four slots; a case passes only when both of its runs passed), with one difference: the two document cases ran with the documents helper, the short documents skill, the syntax check and the no-format rule that #2455 ships, so this row holds only once that change is in. Smoke needs no document. The decision it backs is docs/adr/0094-the-star-goes-to-a-model-that-runs-the-agent.md.

notes: UD-Q4_K_XL with its F16 projector: smoke 2 of 2; with the documents helper, pdf-brief 2 of 2 and board-pack 2 of 2 (22 Nov 2026, the experiment's version of #2455).

On #2455's final text (096cb6eb7), 23 Nov 2026: pdf-brief 2 of 2 and board-pack 2 of 2. On its earlier text, whose no-format rule had been cut to one sentence (684b70a6f): pdf-brief 1 of 2, board-pack 0 of 2, the agent offering a summary instead of a document.
Without the helper, as the app shipped before #2455: pdf-brief 1 of 2, board-pack 0 of 2.
In the maintainer's own use of the app on 23 Nov 2026 it was more reliable in Studio than Spark-X2.6-4B, which this list does not measure.
